title: Known issue in 1.12: two Certificates sharing a secretName spawn endless CertificateRequests

detection.reason: `secretName` is deliberately left out of the Certificate projection (it names a Secret), so two Certificates pointing at one Secret cannot be paired from the inventory

quote: If two Certificate resources are incorrectly configured to have the same target Secret resource, cert-manager will generate a MANY CertificateRequests, possibly causing high CPU usage and/ or high costs due to the large number of certificates issued (see https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/6406).
remediation: Give every Certificate in a namespace its own `secretName` before moving onto 1.12, or skip to 1.13.2 or later where the storm is fixed.
verifyCommand: kubectl get certificates -A -o json | jq -r '.items | group_by(.metadata.namespace + "/" + .spec.secretName) | .[] | select(.[1] != null) | "\(.[0].metadata.namespace) secret shared by \([.[].metadata.name] | join(","))"'  # each row is a Secret two Certificates fight over; NO rows = clean

title: v1.12.0–v1.12.2 leak memory in cainjector and ship a broken cmctl check — install the latest 1.12 patch

detection.reason: the patch version you will install is not a fact of the current cluster

quote: cainjector contains a memory leak due to re-assignment of a log variable (see https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/issues/6217). The fix will be released in v1.12.3. See https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/6232 for context.
remediation: Install the latest 1.12 patch (1.12.3 or later), not 1.12.0–1.12.2.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("cert-manager")) | .spec.template.spec.containers[].image'  # lists, does not judge: after the upgrade every tag should be v1.12.3 or later
coversNotes: `cmctl` API check is broken in v1.12.1.

title: Challenge names are calculated differently — upgrade with no ACME issuance in flight

detection.reason: Challenge objects are not collected, and whether an issuance is in flight is a fact of the moment you upgrade; ACME issuers are the only ones that create Challenges

quote: this PR slightly changes how the name of the Challenge resources are calculated. To avoid duplicate issuances due to the Challenge resource being recreated, ensure that there is no in-progress ACME certificate issuance when you upgrade to this version of cert-manager.
remediation: Upgrade when no Challenge is pending: wait for in-flight ACME issuances to finish (or delete stuck Challenges). A Challenge in flight during the upgrade is recreated under its new name, which can issue a duplicate certificate.
verifyCommand: kubectl get challenges.acme.cert-manager.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.state != "valid") | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) state=\(.status.state // "pending")"'  # each row is an issuance in flight; upgrade when NO rows print
